dialogues.jp: 風呂から上がり、ベッドに腰掛けて一息つく。
dialogues.en:
Out from the bath, and onto the bed in little more than a
breath.
dialogues.text:
Out from the bath, and onto the bed in little more than a
breath.

dialogues.jp: 「今日で事実上、付属の生活も終わりか」

とは言え、本校に上がっても、結局は同じ学園
の同じ敷地に通うのだから、特に変化はない。
dialogues.en:
Although really, since we're just ascending into the main
school, the school doesn't change and the surroundings don't
change, so it's not much of a variation.
dialogues.text:
Although really, since we're just ascending into the main
school, the school doesn't change and the surroundings don't
change, so it's not much of a variation.

dialogues.jp:
面子も同じ。ただ、多少の増減はある訳で、少
しは感慨深いものを感じる。
dialogues.en:
My feelings were pretty much the same way. No strong
variations here or there; just casual feelings about the
entire thing.
dialogues.text:
My feelings were pretty much the same way. No strong
variations here or there; just casual feelings about the
entire thing.

dialogues.jp: 後は制服が変わる……うむ。
dialogues.en: My uniform will change as well... hm.
dialogues.text: My uniform will change as well... hm.

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず、明日っから卒パの準備だな……」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, tomorrow begins the graduation party
preparations..."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, tomorrow begins the graduation party
preparations..."

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットしておく。
dialogues.en: I no longer need to set my alarm clock.
dialogues.text: I no longer need to set my alarm clock.

dialogues.jp:
最近は自分でも慣れたのか、今までセットして
いた時刻に目が覚めるようになっていた。
dialogues.en:
I've become nearly accustomed to it, but there's no need for
me to wake up at a certain time now.
dialogues.text:
I've become nearly accustomed to it, but there's no need for
me to wake up at a certain time now.

dialogues.jp: 結構適当な時間に針を合わせて｛あくび／欠伸｝をする。
dialogues.en: This time, I'd get up when I want to.
dialogues.text: This time, I'd get up when I want to.

dialogues.jp: 再び横になり目を閉じる。

直ぐに、気だるさが全身に回り、俺は意識を閉
ざした……。
dialogues.en: Immediately after, my consciousness left my entire body...
dialogues.text: Immediately after, my consciousness left my entire body...

dialogues.jp:
こうして、付属最後の授業を終えてみると、う
ん、それほど感慨深いものでもないのかもしれ
ない。
dialogues.en:
With the final classes over, I didn't feel any strong
emotions either way.
dialogues.text:
With the final classes over, I didn't feel any strong
emotions either way.

dialogues.jp:
いや、それでも面子にそれなりに変化があるし
やっぱりこう、思うところはあるかもなぁ。
dialogues.en:
That's probably because that nothing much will really
change.
dialogues.text:
That's probably because that nothing much will really
change.

dialogues.jp:
ま、何にせよ、明日からは卒パの準備期間か。
寝よ寝よ。
dialogues.en:
Well, whatever the case, tomorrow's just graduation party
prepartions. Sleep, sleep.
dialogues.text:
Well, whatever the case, tomorrow's just graduation party
prepartions. Sleep, sleep.
